findings.claim: Import permanently drops stats that Export itself wrote: DailyView.importStats keeps only wins whose seed is in 1...Game.maxSeed (1,000,000) and only daily records whose dayIndex is in 0...todayIndex()+2, while StatsBackup.make exports every entry. Restoring the app's own untouched backup onto a fresh install silently lost a real win on deal #872,465,152 and the whole Bronze+Silver+Gold+Flawless record for the Aug 11 sandbox day (dayIndex -1) - both of them earned through normal play of the shipped pre-epoch sandbox days - and reported them as 'Skipped 2 invalid entries', directly contradicting the section's own promise 'Importing merges - it never erases progress.'

repro: Fresh install. Win the Aug 11 sandbox day (Daily > calendar > Aug 11 > Play; its deal is #872,465,152, i.e. > maxSeed) and win today's daily (deal #10,011). [Wins were reached here by injecting a near-complete board into UserDefaults key causeway.game with challengeDay -1 / 10 and letting Auto-finish complete it, so the app's own recordWin()/recordChallengeResult() wrote the stores - see .qa-loop/scratch/qa-worker-2/mkwin2.py + inject2.sh]
Daily > scroll to BACKUP > Export > Save. Note reads 'Stats exported.'; the file contains daily keys -1 and 10 and wins 777, 10011, 872465152 (attached exported-backup.json).
Tap Import and pick that same file: note reads 'Imported - merged 1 day (0 new) and 2 deals (0 new). Skipped 2 invalid entries.' on the SAME device with nothing hand-edited.
xcrun simctl uninstall + install (simulates a new device / reinstall), launch, Daily > BACKUP > Import > pick Causeway-Stats-2026-08-22.json.

Note reads 'Imported - merged 1 day (1 new) and 2 deals (2 new). Skipped 2 invalid entries.' Calendar cell Aug 11 has no medal/star; UserDefaults causeway.wins = {777, 10011} only and causeway.daily = {10} only. The sandbox day's four tiers and the #872,465,152 win are gone with no way to get them back.

findings.note: TRAP: those two range checks are the sanitizer that makes TC-11.4 pass (a hand-edited backup with seeds 0/1000001, day -3/9999 and zero moves/secs was correctly skipped, and no best score was poisoned). Do not simply delete them - widen them to what the app can legitimately produce (sandbox dayIndex >= -preSeeds.count, and win seeds up to the sandbox seed range / any seed the Deal # alert accepts) while keeping the moves>0 / secs>0 checks. Secondary, same fix site: the note calls the user's own untouched export 'invalid entries' and never says which entries were dropped.
